params.q: What is the health cover amount per family under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?

search_parameters.q: What is the health cover amount per family under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?

response.markdown:
**₹5 lakh per family per year** — a family-floater cover for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation at empanelled public and private hospitals, with no cap on family size, age, or number of admissions. [0] [1]

(Additionally, senior citizens aged 70+ get a separate ₹5 lakh cover: a top-up if their family already holds an AB-PMJAY card, or a fresh family cover otherwise.) [2] [3] [4] [5]
